QuestInfo.name: The Outsider
QuestInfo.0: The town watchmen were entertaining, but hardly insightful. You're going to have to look higher up the food chain. Get some information from #b#p2152016##k.
QuestInfo.1: There is another watchman named #b#p2153000##k #boutside of town#k, who's known to take supplies for himself. Could he be the one selling hats?
QuestInfo.2: You met with #p2153000#, a Black Wings watchman.

0.0: Shouldn't you be spending some time to better yourself? You're just loitering around. There's a fellow named #b#p2153000##k outside of the town that shares your enjoyment for doing nothing.
0.1: He's quite the intelligent man, truthfully. A master of claiming supplies that don't belong to him without getting caught. He'll never be an officer with that sort of selfish thinking, but you might learn a thing or two.

yes.0: #bWalk east from town#k. You'll see #p2153000# right before you reach the mines.

no.0: Well then, just loiter around the town if you want. Not my problem.

1.0: What do you want? I have duties to perform and I will not let you get in my way. Every second I spend talking to you is a meso unearned.
